name: Grubenwart Tiefgenug
visual_intent: HISTORICAL mine worker: broad low ink splat, scuffed leather miner cap with unlit little candle bracket ABOVE eyes, short wooden-handled pickaxe and small brass safety lantern at flank. Heavy uneven lids, deep crooked closed toothless frown
biography: Considers daylight an administrative rumour. His lantern divides HyperNorm tunnels into known and forbidden. A dissonant card illuminates an exit missing from both categories. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Tageslicht ist bislang nur vom Hörensagen bekannt.

name: Bohrknecht Förderlich
personality: Tightens every joint except the one in the official argument.
visual_intent: EARLY20th-century oil roughneck: tall crooked pear blob, brown flatcap, small canvas bib patch, one hefty old pipe wrench and tiny black oilcan. Fierce delighted open grin with TWO upper teeth, one eyebrow high
biography: Tightens every joint except the one in the official argument. His wrench tightens every HyperNorm joint marked negotiable. A dissonant card keeps finding pressure where the report promises none. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung hält mehr aus als die Begründung.

name: Geologin Fundstelle
personality: Can find a deposit more easily than an agreed explanation of it.
visual_intent: CURRENT mine surveyor: round top-heavy blob, white hardhat with small lamp ABOVE eyes, subtle lashes, holds one simple violet rock core and chunky handheld scanner pointed toward core. Bulging unequal eyes and tiny off-centre toothless open oval mouth
biography: Can find a deposit more easily than an agreed explanation of it. She scans a HyperNorm rock core that contains two apparently incompatible histories. Neither fits the approved sample tray. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Fund ist gesichert. Seine Deutung nicht.

name: Bohrmeister Druckhalt
personality: Keeps the pressure within limits while the limits keep moving.
visual_intent: CURRENT drilling specialist: squat square rounded splat, ochre helmet, two small orange vest panels only, compact pressure gauge attached to one little shutoff valve. Side-eye, enormous pursed toothless lower lip same dark-violet material
biography: Keeps the pressure within limits while the limits keep moving. His valve admits either acceptable pressure or an incident. A dissonant card asks whether comfortable was ever considered. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Grenzwert wurde der Lage nachgeführt.

name: Asteroidenhauerin Splitterruh
personality: Finds solid work in a universe determined to remain mostly empty.
visual_intent: SCI-FI asteroid miner: tall hooked splat, small teal retro-space work helmet OPEN FACE no visor, two lashes, tiny copper shoulder fittings not humanoid spacesuit, compact blunt spiral hand-drill and one little copper ore nugget. Wide crooked triumphant grin with ONE upper tooth
biography: Finds solid work in a universe determined to remain mostly empty. She drills HyperNorm certainty from an asteroid officially classified as empty. A dissonant card has already made a home inside it. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Leere erwies sich als erstaunlich ergiebig.

name: Vakuumförderer Restdruck
personality: Collects the last drop before somebody changes the definition of a drop.
visual_intent: SCI-FI space oil technician: broad drooping splat, padded plum cap with one small dial ABOVE eyes, short brass hose ending at a sealed palm-sized amber sample cylinder, visibly connected. Raised worried brows, closed nervous toothless zigzag lips
biography: Collects the last drop before somebody changes the definition of a drop. His sealed HyperNorm sample keeps producing bubbles after its contents are declared settled. A dissonant card counts them as questions. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der letzte Tropfen hat weiteren Gesprächsbedarf.
